fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-06-03 at approximately 17:05, it was reported that a message about KYC expiry led the complainant to a website where account credentials were entered, and Rs. 18,500 was transferred out. The complaint was lodged by Malathi Selvi (9000000386). Rajesh Rajan (9000000302) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Transaction details refer to the receiving account SYN-ACC-100071. The complainant could not identify the person involved. Items referenced in the complaint: digital documents and social media screenshots. The account SYN-ACC-100071 was also referenced in FIR-2026-00046, so the two matters may be potentially related.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim reported receiving a suspicious link that imitated a bank notification.
fields.Keywords: phishing, suspicious link, college road, witness, evening, screenshot, digital document, receiving account
